data.name: copies_only_on_owner_insert
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER copies_only_on_owner_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON game_copies
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Un gioco dentro una collection eredita le copie della collection')
    WHERE (SELECT parent_id FROM games WHERE id = NEW.game_id) IS NOT NULL
       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games g WHERE g.id = NEW.game_id);
END;

data.name: parent_must_be_collection_insert
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER parent_must_be_collection_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON games
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Un gioco può essere contenuto solo in una collection')
    WHERE NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE((SELECT is_collection FROM games WHERE id = NEW.parent_id), 0) <> 1;
END;

    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Un gioco può essere contenuto solo in una collection')

data.name: no_nested_collections
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER no_nested_collections
BEFORE UPDATE ON games
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Una collection non può essere contenuta in una collection')
    WHERE NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games child WHERE child.parent_id = OLD.id);
END;

data.name: collection_with_children_cannot_be_demoted
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER collection_with_children_cannot_be_demoted
BEFORE UPDATE ON games
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'La collection contiene ancora dei giochi: scioglila prima')
    WHERE OLD.is_collection = 1 AND NEW.is_collection = 0
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games child WHERE child.parent_id = OLD.id);
END;

data.name: child_must_not_own_copies
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER child_must_not_own_copies
BEFORE UPDATE ON games
BEGIN
    SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Rimuovi le copie proprie prima di mettere il gioco in una collection')
    WHERE NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.parent_id IS NULL
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM game_copies c WHERE c.game_id = OLD.id);
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "consoles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "short_label" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(short_label) BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND trim(short_label) <> ''), "family" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'altro' CHECK (family IN ('nintendo', 'playstation', 'xbox', 'sega', 'pc', 'altro')), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "genres" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "companies" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0), "name_norm" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "games" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) > 0), "title_norm" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "series_id" INTEGER REFERENCES series(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "developer_id" INTEGER REFERENCES companies(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "publisher_id" INTEGER REFERENCES companies(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "release_year" INTEGER CHECK (release_year IS NULL OR release_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2100), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'backlog' CHECK (status IN ('backlog', 'arcade', 'abbandonato', 'in_corso', 'finito', 'completato')), "is_replayable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_replayable IN (0, 1)), "has_post_game" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (has_post_game IN (0, 1)), "has_achievements" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (has_achievements IN (0, 1)), "all_achievements_unlocked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (all_achievements_unlocked IN (0, 1)), "has_dlc" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (has_dlc IN (0, 1)), "is_collection" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_collection IN (0, 1)), "parent_id" INTEGER REFERENCES games(id), "rating_story" REAL CHECK (rating_story IS NULL OR(rating_story BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND rating_story * 2 = CAST(rating_story * 2 AS INTEGER))), "rating_gameplay" REAL CHECK (rating_gameplay IS NULL OR(rating_gameplay BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND rating_gameplay * 2 = CAST(rating_gameplay * 2 AS INTEGER))), "rating_graphics" REAL CHECK (rating_graphics IS NULL OR(rating_graphics BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND rating_graphics * 2 = CAST(rating_graphics * 2 AS INTEGER))), "rating_soundtrack" REAL CHECK (rating_soundtrack IS NULL OR(rating_soundtrack BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND rating_soundtrack * 2 = CAST(rating_soundtrack * 2 AS INTEGER))), "overall_rating" REAL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN COALESCE(rating_story, rating_gameplay, rating_graphics, rating_soundtrack) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE(COALESCE(rating_story, 0) + COALESCE(rating_gameplay, 0) + COALESCE(rating_graphics, 0) + COALESCE(rating_soundtrack, 0))* 1.0 /((rating_story IS NOT NULL)+(rating_gameplay IS NOT NULL)+(rating_graphics IS NOT NULL)+(rating_soundtrack IS NOT NULL))END) VIRTUAL, "cover_path" TEXT, "cover_thumb_path" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()), "players" INTEGER CHECK (players IS NULL OR players IN (1, 2, 4)), CHECK(all_achievements_unlocked = 0 OR has_achievements = 1), CHECK(NOT(is_collection = 1 AND parent_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id <> id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_copies" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "console_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES consoles(id), "format" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (format IN ('fisico', 'digitale')), UNIQUE(game_id, console_id, format));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "detached_copies" ("game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "console_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES consoles(id), "format" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (format IN ('fisico', 'digitale')), PRIMARY KEY(game_id, console_id, format));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_platforms" ("game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "console_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES consoles(id), PRIMARY KEY(game_id, console_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_genres" ("game_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "genre_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES genres(id), PRIMARY KEY(game_id, genre_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE VIEW effective_copies AS SELECT g.id AS game_id, c.console_id AS console_id, c.format AS format FROM games AS g JOIN game_copies AS c ON c.game_id = COALESCE(g.parent_id, g.id)
CREATE VIEW stat_games AS SELECT g.id AS game_id FROM games AS g WHERE g.is_collection = 0 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games AS child WHERE child.parent_id = g.id)
CREATE VIEW game_consoles AS SELECT game_id, console_id, format FROM game_copies UNION ALL SELECT game_id, console_id, NULL AS format FROM game_platforms
CREATE INDEX games_sort_title ON games (sort_title)
CREATE INDEX games_title_norm ON games (title_norm)
CREATE INDEX games_status ON games (status)
CREATE INDEX games_parent_id ON games (parent_id)
CREATE INDEX games_release_year ON games (release_year)
CREATE INDEX games_overall_rating ON games (overall_rating)
CREATE INDEX game_copies_console_id ON game_copies (console_id)
CREATE INDEX detached_copies_console_id ON detached_copies (console_id)
CREATE INDEX game_platforms_console_id ON game_platforms (console_id)
CREATE INDEX game_genres_genre_id ON game_genres (genre_id)
